notes: 2018_00_link.txt is the HR Supported Parental Leave page; 2018_01_note.txt repeats its site navigation.

Governing document: the Queen's-QUFA Collective Agreement 2015-19 (as amended May 2017), in force on 2018-02-27; tenured and tenure-track faculty are in the bargaining unit (Art. 1.3). The two HR pages are university-wide summaries (academic and non-academic staff); where they differ from the agreement (maternity leave start within 12 vs 8 weeks of delivery; pay week 1 at 100% then 16 weeks of top-up vs weeks 1-2 at 100% then 15), the agreement governs (source precedence).

R21: EI's waiting period was one week on the reference date. The agreement's maternity schedule (two weeks at 100%) is coded as written. Parental top-up: 33.3.3.5 (two weeks at 100%) applies only to a member subject to a two-week wait, so 33.3.3.6 (top-up for 15 weeks) is coded. The HR parental page's week-1 100% payment is coded as c9, flagged summary_only.

U8 paths not coded: Maternity Leave Without Top-Up (33.3.2) for members without one year of service is the statutory pregnancy leave (c11); Parental Leave Without Top-Up of up to 37 weeks (33.3.4.2) for members without a paid leave; compassionate leave of one week for members with under a year of service.

Birth parent chain: Maternity Leave With Top-Up 20 (c1; c2 weeks 1-2 at 100% -> c3 top-up weeks 3-17 -> c4 full salary weeks 18-20), with ESA pregnancy leave 17 alongside (c11) -> Parental Leave Without Top-Up up to 52 (c10, from week 20), with ESA parental leave 61 from week 17 (c12); EI maternity 15 from week 2 (c5) -> EI parental 35 (c6); c1 lies within the one-year adjustment of duties from the birth (c13). Parental Leave With Top-Up (c7) for a birth parent follows c1 but the combined 20-week limit leaves it nothing after a full maternity leave.

Non-birth parent chain: Parental Leave With Top-Up 15 (c7; top-up c8 from week 2; c9 summary-only week 1) with ESA parental leave 63 alongside (c12) -> Parental Leave Without Top-Up up to 52 (c10); EI parental 35 from week 2 (c6); c7 lies within the one-year adjustment of duties (c13). Compassionate leave with pay (c23, U5) is unlinked.

Not components: bereavement leave (death), leave to seek office, court leave, academic (sabbatical) and administrative leave, reduced teaching for research (37.4.4), teaching-schedule accommodation for family circumstances (37.2.8, Appendix I), adoptive 'pre-custody' accommodation (33.3.3.9, no defined benefit), disability accommodation including modified tenure time requirements (9.2, checklist: disability accommodation), child-care cost reimbursement (Appendix M).
